scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.db-port.yml up -d db
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.test:server: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w server
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w web
